source_review.notes: Reviewed all ten references. ABA characterization and constructions were checked against Michael's IBM report record; the canonical stack and correctness context against Treiber and Herlihy-Wing; lifetime distinctions against Michael and Brown; and current compare-exchange, stamped-pair, pointer-atomic, and LR/SC behavior against the C++ draft, Java 21, Rust, and RISC-V documentation. C++/Java/Rust/RISC-V/Fraser resolved directly, IEEE returned accepted metadata, ACM denied automated retrieval, and both IBM report records were discoverable through indexed metadata but timed out from the shell. Inaccessible publisher/report pages support scoped attribution only, not quotations or unobserved details.

evidence: Definitions and Notation consistently defines X, a, d(a), the A-to-B-to-A history, tagged pair T=(p,g), M=2^k, modular successor, observation duration O, transition rate r, reuse delay R, and retirement/reclamation states.
The chapter keeps representation equality, object identity, generation, lifetime, history detection, and abstract correctness as distinct terms.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Checked modular arithmetic, units, state-pair notation, inequality direction, and the scope of sufficient rather than necessary conditions.

Recomputed Exercise 2: 2^24=16,777,216, rO=250,000*40=10,000,000, and arithmetic margin 6,777,216.

numerical_recomputation.notes: The rates are stipulated bounds and illustrative arithmetic, not empirical reliability measurements.

evidence: Under atomic pair updates and fewer than M relevant advances during a live observation, modular generation cannot return to the expected g after an intervening transition.
The sufficient bound r*O<M follows because at most rO same-location relevant advances can occur during an observation; delayed reuse instead requires a protocol-specific R>O relation.

evidence: Reviewed harmless cycles, pointer reuse, logical ABA, unchanged pointer with changed history, first/last modular tags, exact wrap, burst rates, indefinitely paused or failed observers, restart, and adversarial replay.

Reviewed torn fields, missing increments, weak/spurious CAS, LR/SC reservation failure, wide-atomic fallback, pointer provenance, immediate reuse, managed memory, cancellation after commitment, shutdown, and high-stakes commands.

evidence: Every proposal-invalidating transition advances the atomically compared generation, and a failed comparison invalidates every fact derived from the old pair.
Every dereference is protected and revalidated independently; retirement precedes reclamation and reuse; cancellation and restart preserve committed generation truth.
invariant_checking.notes: Checked invariants across observe, protect, validate, dereference, derive, compare, retry, commit, retire, reclaim, reuse, cancel, close, restart, and destroy.

evidence: The counterexample template requires a retained fact, invalidating A-to-B-to-A transitions, stale CAS acceptance, and a named violated invariant, so value repetition alone is not mislabeled as a defect.

The tagged-state argument proves rejection only before wrap and only under atomic-pair, complete-advance, refresh, and lifetime assumptions; the obligation matrix keeps linearizability and progress separate.
proof_review.notes: This is a scoped proof argument and review, not mechanized source refinement, weak-memory/reclamation verification, infinite-state liveness proof, or safety certification.

evidence: The chapter labels rO<M and R>O as simple sufficient relations with real-proof qualifications rather than universal theorems.
CAS safety, ABA detection, lifetime safety, publication, linearizability, lock-freedom, restart safety, and operational monitoring remain distinct claims.

pedagogical_review.notes: The review sheet foregrounds equality versus history and tags versus lifetime; exposition progresses from counterexample to remedies and lifecycle; the finite model is reproducible; ten examples serve distinct purposes; and five exercises progress from precise definition to rail-safety transfer with complete matching answers.

limitations: Internal authoring, source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external concurrency-theory, formal-methods, C++/Java/Rust, compiler, ISA, memory-reclamation, embedded, distributed-systems, medical, railway, regulatory, operational, or safety review is claimed.
